name: D-test — Arabic diction (donor vs v2, AR/NAR split)
description: Pronunciation-first blinded listening test. Question: does the qahh Quran donor (quran_ahh_r32, alpha=0.1) improve Arabic diction vs v2-only, and does the AR branch bleed recitation (tajweed) prosody while NAR adds articulation? Judge ONLY pronunciation in the primary block; melody/mood are controls and must not drive the call. summary_metric = diction.

criteria.label: Diction / makhraj correctness
criteria.help: Judge ONLY Arabic pronunciation: makhraj, harakat, letter identity. Ignore melody, mix and mood. Reserve 5 for a take with no error.

criteria.label: Word intelligibility

scale_labels.5: every word clear on first listen

criteria.help: Could a native listener transcribe the words without replaying?

criteria.label: Clearly-wrong sounds (count)
criteria.help: Count each clearly wrong letter / haraka ONCE across the whole take. 0 is rare — count honestly; this is the errors-per-take input for errors/100-words.

criteria.label: Which sounds were wrong?

options.t: Emphatic / mufakham — ط ض ظ ص

criteria.help: Tick every class you heard wrong. Tick 'None' only if diction was clean.

criteria.label: Recitation (tajweed) prosody bleeding into the singing?
criteria.help: Does qira'ah prosody (madd stretching, idgham/ikhfa, iqlab, qalqalah, waqf pauses) leak into the vocal?

criteria.label: Which tajweed features leaked?
criteria.help: Shown only when the flag above is Yes.

criteria.label: Singing vs recitation cadence
criteria.help: How far does it drift from singing into cantillation / tarteel? (AR-branch overcorrection signal.)

criteria.label: Articulation crispness
criteria.help: Consonant closure and clarity — independent of whether the sound is the CORRECT one. (NAR-branch signal.)

criteria.label: Melody / mood (control)
criteria.help: Musical fit only. CONTROL field — expect this roughly unchanged across arms; do not let it drive the pronunciation verdict.

criteria.label: Keep this take — on pronunciation alone?
Notes
criteria.help: Quote the exact mispronounced word + timecode where you can.
